description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have Spark Double enter as a copy of Galadriel.
When Spark Double enters, Galadriel triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Galadriel.
When Galadriel enters, Spark Double triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
